source_caption:
Ad 🔥 Invincible is back, and this season is bringing the chaos 😭💥

If you think being a superhero is all about saving the day, Invincible is here to prove otherwise.
The story follows Mark Grayson as he continues growing into his powers while dealing with enemies, family secrets, impossible choices, and the pressure of becoming a hero.

What makes Invincible stand out is how it mixes superhero action with emotional moments, unexpected twists, humor, and serious consequences. Every episode feels like something could completely change the story.

And just when you think you know what’s coming… Invincible proves you wrong. 👀🔥
Watch Invincible on Prime Video.

source_details.synopsis: Invincible is an American adult animated superhero television series created by Robert Kirkman for the streaming service Amazon Prime Video, based on the Image Comics comic book series of the same name he co-created with Cory Walker and Ryan Ottley. It is produced by Skybound Entertainment, Wind Sun Sky Entertainment, Point Grey Pictures, and Amazon MGM Studios. The series follows teenager Mark Grayson, a human-alien hybrid, who becomes a crime-fighting superhero known as "Invincible" under the guidance of his father, Nolan / Omni-Man, the most powerful superhero on the planet. As he adjusts to his new powers, Mark struggles to balance his personal life with his superhero duties and is force
